project.title: Community Food Support and Outreach Pilot
project.objective: Design and run a 6-week pilot that combines surplus food redistribution with basic outreach to vulnerable community members.
deliverables: Mapped process for collecting, sorting and packing surplus food
Weekly community food support schedule and delivery routes
Basic wellbeing and needs-check protocol for doorstep interactions
Training brief for all staff and volunteers involved in the pilot
Pilot monitoring log and end-of-pilot summary report
constraints: Pilot duration limited to 6 weeks with fixed end date
Must comply with food safety, hygiene and data protection rules
Use only existing vehicles, storage space and equipment
Outreach questions must stay non-clinical and non-diagnostic
Limited budget for packaging and printing of materials

risks.risk: Food safety incident due to improper handling or storage.
risks.mitigation: Provide clear handling checklist, brief all staff, and perform spot checks during the pilot.

risks.risk: Low uptake from target households leading to wasted effort and food.
risks.mitigation: Coordinate with community organisations to pre-identify households and confirm interest before first deliveries.

risks.risk: Staff overwhelmed by combining operational work with outreach conversations.
risks.mitigation: Keep outreach script short, clarify time limits, and allow opt-out for staff who are not comfortable.

risks.risk: Breach of privacy or mishandling of sensitive information from households.
risks.mitigation: Use anonymised codes in logs, avoid collecting unnecessary data, and train staff on confidentiality basics.

risks.risk: Logistical delays causing late deliveries or missed households.
risks.mitigation: Pilot routes on a small scale first week, build buffer time, and maintain a simple incident log for quick adjustments.

themes.why_relevant: Team must integrate food handling, delivery and short wellbeing checks without overloading staff.
Surplus food redistribution must strictly follow safety rules to protect households and the organisation.
Outreach notes and delivery logs must be accurate while protecting household identities.
Pilot should reach isolated or vulnerable residents and respect their preferences and dignity.
Clear, simple procedures help non-specialist staff deliver consistent quality across all steps.

backlog.task: Define target households and basic eligibility criteria with community partners
definition_of_done: Eligibility criteria agreed and documented
Initial list of target households created with anonymised IDs
Community partners confirm feasibility of outreach scope

backlog.task: Design surplus food collection and shelf-sorting process for the pilot
definition_of_done: Step-by-step process drafted from receipt to packing
Storage and rotation rules aligned with food safety guidance
Process reviewed by food production operator for feasibility

backlog.task: Set up basic food safety and hygiene guidelines for all pilot staff
definition_of_done: Key do's and don'ts documented in simple language
Guidelines validated by internal compliance contact
Guidelines shared in channel and acknowledged by all roles

backlog.task: Map and optimise weekly delivery routes for target households
definition_of_done: Draft routes created with estimated timings
Feasibility checked against existing delivery workload
Final route plan approved by project team

backlog.task: Create a short doorstep wellbeing and needs-check script
definition_of_done: Script limited to a few open and closed questions
Language checked for non-judgmental and non-clinical tone
Script approved by project team and saved as guideline

backlog.task: Draft a simple packing checklist for weekly food parcels
definition_of_done: Checklist covers item types, quantities and expiry checks
Checklist tested on a sample packing run
Feedback from food production operator incorporated

backlog.task: Define labelling and basic tracking method for parcels and households
definition_of_done: Label format and coding scheme documented
Tracking sheet template created for weekly use
Method validated to avoid personal identifiers on labels

backlog.task: Prepare a shared log template for deliveries and outreach notes
definition_of_done: Columns defined for date, route, household code and key notes
Privacy considerations reviewed by social worker
Template stored centrally and linked in channel

backlog.task: Plan and run a short briefing session for all pilot participants
definition_of_done: Agenda covers objectives, roles, safety and privacy
All roles invited and time agreed in channel
Key points and decisions summarised and shared afterwards

backlog.task: Conduct a one-week dry run with limited households and adjust processes
definition_of_done: Dry run completed with at least 5 households
Operational issues captured in incident log
Agreed list of process tweaks documented

backlog.task: Monitor weekly pilot metrics and qualitative feedback
definition_of_done: Weekly summary of deliveries and key observations posted
Any serious concerns escalated via agreed pathway
Trends and recurring issues flagged to team

backlog.task: Compile end-of-pilot summary report with recommendations
definition_of_done: Report includes reach, issues, and community feedback
Operational learnings from all roles integrated
Clear recommendation on whether and how to scale

artifacts.used_for: Summarises objectives, scope, roles and high-level timeline for the pilot.

artifacts.title: Food Safety and Hygiene Quick Guide
artifacts.used_for: Provides simple rules for handling, storing and transporting surplus food safely.

artifacts.title: Weekly Parcel Packing Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Ensures each parcel meets agreed content, quantity and expiry standards before dispatch.

artifacts.title: Doorstep Wellbeing and Needs-Check Script
artifacts.used_for: Gives staff a short, consistent script for respectful doorstep conversations.

artifacts.title: Household and Route Tracking Sheet
artifacts.used_for: Tracks anonymised household codes, assigned routes and delivery status each week.

artifacts.title: Delivery and Outreach Log Template
artifacts.used_for: Captures date, route, household code and key non-sensitive outreach notes.

artifacts.title: Pilot Operational Issues Log
artifacts.used_for: Records food safety, timing or process incidents and how they were resolved.

artifacts.title: End-of-Pilot Summary and Recommendations
artifacts.used_for: Consolidates outcomes, lessons learned and proposals for future roll-out.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on pilot scope, roles and initial household targeting approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message sharing the pilot overview and asking for feedback on scope and roles.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm final pilot objective and success criteria for the 6-week period.
Agree on eligibility criteria and approximate number of households for the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and agree on the end-to-end operational flow from surplus collection to delivery.
threads_plan.trigger: Operations-focused message proposing a draft process for collection, sorting, packing and dispatch.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the standard process for collecting, sorting and packing surplus food.
Confirm the weekly delivery schedule and route ownership for the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalise safety, privacy and doorstep interaction guidelines.
threads_plan.trigger: Message sharing draft food safety guide and doorstep script for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the food safety and hygiene quick guide for the pilot.
Agree on the final version of the doorstep wellbeing and needs-check script.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Set up tracking, labelling and logging tools before the dry run.
threads_plan.trigger: Message asking for feedback on proposed labelling scheme and log templates.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Choose the labelling and coding scheme to use for parcels and households.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review dry run results and agree adjustments and next steps.
threads_plan.trigger: Post-dry-run summary message sharing key issues and asking for input on changes.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on process changes and confirm go/no-go for full 6-week pilot roll-out.

channel_rituals: Weekly async check-in every Monday summarising last week and priorities for the next.
Mid-week quick update thread focused on any operational or safety issues encountered.
Post-delivery debrief message after the first dry run and after week 3 of the pilot.
End-of-pilot retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and improvement ideas.
